categories.main_business_segments: JGC Holdings operates two primary business segments: the Comprehensive Engineering (EPC) business and the Functional Materials Manufacturing business. The EPC segment focuses on planning, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of plants and facilities for sectors such as oil, gas, LNG, chemicals, nuclear, metals, bio, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, logistics, IT, and environmental protection. The Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells catalysts, nanomaterials, environmental catalysts, electronic materials, ceramics, and next-generation energy materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced EPC project management, modular construction methods, digital transformation (DX) in engineering (such as AI-driven design, digital twins, and 3D printing), and proprietary process technologies for carbon management (CCS/CCUS), chemical recycling, and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) production. The Functional Materials segment leverages proprietary catalyst synthesis, nanotechnology, advanced ceramics manufacturing, and collaborative R&D for high-performance materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major oil and gas companies (including national oil companies), chemical and petrochemical firms, power and utility companies, pharmaceutical and healthcare providers, and manufacturers in electronics and automotive sectors. Major end markets include energy infrastructure, sustainable energy, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, and environmental solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: JGC operates globally, with significant projects and subsidiaries in Japan, Southeast Asia (notably Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia), the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, Oman), North America (USA, Canada), Africa, and Europe. The majority of revenue is generated from overseas projects, especially in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as an EPC contractor (midstream/downstream) in the supply chain, delivering integrated engineering, procurement, and construction services for large-scale industrial plants. In the Functional Materials segment, it acts as a midstream supplier, providing advanced materials and components to manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening competitiveness in large-scale EPC projects, expanding the functional materials business, and establishing new growth engines in energy transition, resource circulation, and life sciences. R&D focuses on digitalization of EPC, carbon management technologies (CCS/CCUS, SAF), chemical and bio-based recycling, advanced catalysts, high-performance ceramics, and bio-manufacturing platforms. Sustainability and ESG initiatives are integrated into all business activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through EPC project contracts (progress-based revenue recognition), product sales of functional materials, licensing of proprietary technologies, consulting, and operation & maintenance services. The company also receives dividends and management fees from group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other global EPC contractors such as Chiyoda, Toyo Engineering, and international firms like Fluor and Technip Energies. In functional materials, competitors include catalyst and advanced ceramics manufacturers. JGC is positioned as a leading Japanese EPC and technology-driven solutions provider with strong overseas presence and a growing focus on sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated sales were ¥858.1 billion, with a workforce of 8,365 employees. The company has shown revenue growth driven by overseas EPC projects and expansion in functional materials, though profitability has been impacted by project losses and risk provisions. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with a nearly 50% equity ratio and aims for long-term growth through strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JGC emphasizes its ability to deliver complex, large-scale projects globally with advanced risk management, digitalized project execution, and proprietary technologies for decarbonization and resource circulation. Its functional materials business differentiates through high-performance, customized solutions for advanced industries. The company positions itself as a partner for planetary health, supporting clients' sustainability and innovation goals.
